job.title: Software Engineer, Full Stack, Government Products
job.location: Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY
job.pay_full: $166,000 – $195,000 a year base salary (Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY), plus bonus opportunities, equity and benefits

details.about: Robinhood's Government Products team builds and scales systems that support long-term investing and account management for millions of customers, working with product, data and infrastructure partners. This full stack engineer joins a zero-to-one initiative: a brand-new, standalone product, shipping features that span a Go backend and a React web experience.
duties: Build, test and ship features across Go backend services and React front-end experiences for a new standalone product built for security, reliability and scale
Work with Product, Design and external stakeholders to turn requirements into secure, well-tested, maintainable software
Own well-scoped projects from design through release
Move between backend and front-end work as priorities shift
Contribute to code reviews, documentation and team engineering practices
needs: 4+ years building production backend services, ideally in Go or Ruby, with a working understanding of API design and reliable data flows
4+ years building front-end applications with JavaScript frameworks such as React, with familiarity with Node
Comfort working across backend and front end, and willingness to learn quickly on a zero-to-one product
Clean, well-tested code and a strong desire to learn from feedback
Clear communication with Product, Design and cross-functional teammates
This position is restricted to US citizens or lawful permanent residents
nice: Experience with financial products, ledgering, reporting or investment technology
details.benefits: Base pay $166,000 – $195,000 a year in Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC), plus bonus opportunities, equity and benefits; pay depends on job-related factors and location. Robinhood lists performance-driven compensation, bonus programs, equity ownership, 401(k) matching, 100% paid health insurance for employees (90% for dependents), a lifestyle wallet for wellness and learning, employer-paid life and disability insurance, fertility and mental health benefits, company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave and catered meals in the office.
notes: Based in the New York, NY and Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected 3 days per week
Candidates may submit no more than 3 applications to Robinhood in any 90 days
